summary: Added meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed, CENT and the three methods) and routed every rounding and fixed-place formatting in tariffs, standing, tax, cash, credits, report and batch through it, removing the decimal-context line from __init__.py. The original unit tests plus new tests/test_money.py pass (37 tests), and about 5,400 random CLI runs (bill, batch, quote, tariffs; all formats) produced identical output to the original. Quirks kept on purpose: batch rounds band charges and the per kWh figure half to even (its pool threads never had the half-up context), bills, quotes and tariffs round them half up, the whole-unit cash rule never prints -0 while the step rule can print -0.00, and credits stay binary-float.
